feature: Camera capture of a single piece
notes: PaperKarma: camera button; Paper Trail already captures. Source 2

feature: Pick an existing photo from the gallery
notes: PaperKarma allows gallery photos. Source 2

feature: Capture guidance (shoot logo or return address close up)
notes: PaperKarma asks for a clear close-up of name, logo or return address. Paper Trail reads the whole page so this matters less

feature: Photo kept as proof of receipt
notes: PaperKarma keeps the photo as proof. Paper Trail already keeps the original in Drive

feature: Batch capture of many pieces in one session
notes: Not described for PaperKarma (one request per mailer). Paper Trail's deck already batches; keep it

feature: Sender recognition from the photo
notes: PaperKarma matches against 100,000+ mailers; method undisclosed; users say right only about a quarter of the time. Paper Trail uses Claude

feature: Top matches picker when the sender is wrong
notes: PaperKarma shows top 10 matches plus name search. Steal as a one-tap 'not this?' of existing senders and folders

feature: Remember a corrected sender for next time
notes: Not described by PaperKarma. Paper Trail can store per-sender corrections in Firestore

feature: Flag non-stoppable mail (EDDM / Current Resident / political)
notes: PaperKarma refuses these; users dislike no appeal. Paper Trail can just verdict them shred

feature: Detect who the piece is addressed to (person and address)
notes: PaperKarma makes the user pick a saved identity. Claude can read it off the page

feature: Names and addresses book (self / family / previous occupant)
notes: Unlimited identities at PaperKarma. Paper Trail: route previous-occupant mail to shred, family mail to its own folder

feature: Per-sender ledger grouping documents across scans
notes: PaperKarma tracks per mailer request; Paper Trail should group its docs and paperless items by sender

feature: Request history list with status chips
notes: PaperKarma: Success, Processing, Failed, Pending. Paper Trail: To do, Requested, Waiting a cycle, Confirmed, Can't stop

feature: Plain explanation of each status
notes: PaperKarma explains in FAQ only, not in the moment; reviewers complain about weeks in Processing

feature: Expectation timer (results in N weeks / next cycle)
notes: PaperKarma sets an 8 to 12 week window; banks say first eStatement next cycle. Show a check-after date

feature: 'Is this mailer still sending?' follow-up
notes: PaperKarma asks the user; Paper Trail can detect it automatically when a paperless sender's paper shows up in a new scan

feature: Reprocess or escalate a failed request
notes: PaperKarma support reprocesses. Paper Trail equivalent: reopen the sender's steps

feature: Search past requests or senders
notes: No search seen in PaperKarma. Paper Trail needs search across filed docs and senders

feature: Opt-out registry checklist (OptOutPrescreen / DMAchoice / Catalog Choice)
notes: PaperKarma recommends the stack in a blog guide, not in-app. One-time checklist card in Paper Trail

feature: Junk mail verdict with the right opt-out link
notes: PaperKarma sends opt-outs itself. Paper Trail can hand Bryce the correct link or registry per piece

feature: Send opt-outs on the user's behalf
notes: Needs mailer channels and a proxy email; out of scope for a personal app

feature: Go-paperless steps per sender (click path and caveats)
notes: PaperKarma explicitly does not handle bills or statements. Joint holders enroll separately, utilities may need account number and ZIP

feature: Paperless credit or incentive note
notes: Some utilities pay a credit (Muskegon $0.75/month). Claude can mention it if the bill says so

feature: Suggest a new sender to the database
notes: PaperKarma yearly plan feature. Not needed; Claude reads any sender

feature: Impact counters (pieces handled / senders stopped)
notes: PaperKarma markets opt-outs sent and trees. Paper Trail: shredded / filed / switched totals on home

feature: Fast per-piece flow (about 30 seconds)
notes: Most praised thing in reviews. Paper Trail's swipe deck already matches; protect it

feature: No login friction on return visits
notes: PaperKarma sign-up form drew complaints. Paper Trail: persistent auth and server-side Drive refresh token

feature: Free tier then subscription paywall
notes: 4 free requests then $3.99/mo, $15.99/6mo, $24.99/yr, $59.99 lifetime. Not relevant to a personal app

feature: Encryption at rest and TLS
notes: PaperKarma: AWS encryption at rest and TLS. Paper Trail: Firebase and Drive defaults

feature: Proxy email so real address is never shared
notes: PaperKarma relays email to mailers. Only relevant if Paper Trail ever sends requests

feature: No tracking SDKs
notes: PaperKarma's App Store label lists contact info and usage data as used to track you despite 'never sell' claims

feature: Account and data deletion
notes: PaperKarma: by email only and permanent. Paper Trail: a self-serve wipe of Firestore log

feature: Sync to cloud storage of the original
notes: PaperKarma stores nothing but the request. Paper Trail's Drive filing is its core advantage
